description: This Java class 'CredentialsObject' encapsulates device credentials as per the Credentials API, providing various constructors and validation methods for different credential types such as secret-based, pre-shared keys, and X.509 certificates.
external_methods: Standard Java Stream methods (stream, filter, map, collect)

classes.name: CredentialsObject
classes.description: A final class representing device credentials, supporting various credential types, validation, and creation methods, extending JsonBackedValueObject for JSON handling.

methods.name: CredentialsObject
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty credentials object.

methods.name: CredentialsObject
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for creating credentials with deviceId, authId, and type.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Adds a custom property to the credentials object, facilitating flexible JSON structure.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the credential's associated device ID.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID for the credential object.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the credential's type.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the credential's type.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication ID associated with the credentials.

methods.name: setAuthId
methods.description: Sets the authentication ID.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the credentials are enabled for use.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the credentials.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of secrets associated with the credentials.

methods.name: addSecret
methods.description: Appends a secret (JsonObject or Map) to the credentials' secrets list.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates the overall internal state of the credentials object.

methods.name: checkSecrets
methods.description: Validates the secrets conformity to API, including presence and validity periods.

methods.name: checkHashedPassword
methods.description: Validates hashed password secrets for required fields.

methods.name: checkValidityPeriod
methods.description: Validates that 'not before' is before 'not after' in a secret.

methods.name: getTimestampIfPresentForField
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a timestamp from a secret field.

methods.name: getInstant
methods.description: Parses an ISO offset date time string into an Instant.

methods.name: emptySecret
methods.description: Creates an empty secret with specified validity period.

methods.name: fromHashedPassword
methods.description: Constructs credentials with a hashed password secret, supporting optional salt.

methods.name: fromClearTextPassword
methods.description: Constructs credentials from a clear text password by hashing it internally.

methods.name: hashedPasswordSecretForPasswordHash
methods.description: Creates secret JsonObject for password hash with optional salt.

methods.name: hashedPasswordSecretForClearTextPassword
methods.description: Creates secret JsonObject for plain text password.

methods.name: fromPresharedKey
methods.description: Creates credentials using a pre-shared key.

methods.name: fromClientCertificate
methods.description: Creates credentials from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: fromSubjectDn
methods.description: Creates credentials from a subject DN and associated device ID.
